text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan took a brilliant 1st place in 
the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And thanks to the simple secret strategy 
of "Cute appeals to a wider audience than 
Tokusatsu," everything went smoothly—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She claimed a narrow victory over Biko 
Pegasus in the "Kawaii Derby♪" as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up at last is the "All-in-One Final 
Showdown," where top-class rivals gather 
together—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rerunning the Sprinters Stakes. Curren 
Chan was determined to stand at the 
pinnacle of cuteness.
